decisions.reason: The modular plant concept builds on core environmental-technology know-how and has a documented customer saving, so management can interpret its results and refine it through its own R&D, though it may later be folded into the flagship line C.
The mobile slow-speed shredder sits within the firm's established shredding competence, though the new 2024 shredder line E may eventually absorb or replace it.
As a multi-model flagship line extending the firm's modular direction, it draws on accumulated know-how and research cooperation, so management will keep developing it.
The mobile trommel screen is close to the core offer and fits the firm's service and telematics network, making it low risk and easy to learn from and improve.
The new multi-model slow-speed shredder line with its own page builds directly on established shredder expertise, which the firm can readily assimilate and improve.
The spiral shaft screen line extends the firm's screening know-how and was launched only recently, so management will gather market feedback and refine it rather than drop it.
